name: Gurunath D Vernekar
title: Founder and managing partner
cardLine: Has worked with Bengaluru's land and industrial authorities since 2000.
bio: Gurunath founded Verna Developers in 2000 and has advised on commercial, industrial and agricultural property in and around Bengaluru ever since. Seeing how often industrial owners struggled with KIADB paperwork, he co-founded KAIDS with Tejas Vernekar in 2015 to run that work end to end. He leads the firm's client relationships and its reading of the market.

image.alt: Portrait of Gurunath D Vernekar, founder and managing partner of KAIDS

name: Tejas G Vernekar
title: Co-founder, legal and compliance
cardLine: Keeps every file legally sound, from allotment to transfer.
bio: Tejas co-founded KAIDS in 2015 and leads its legal and compliance work. He handles the legal side of allotments, transfers, disputes and statutory documentation, and does the same as co-founder of the sister firm Verna Developers. Clients bring him the files that cannot afford a mistake.

image.alt: Portrait of Tejas G Vernekar, co-founder of KAIDS

name: Ajay G Vernekar
title: Partner, finance and growth
cardLine: Runs finance, subsidies and growth across the group.
bio: Ajay leads finance and growth for KAIDS and heads finance and marketing at Verna Developers. He looks after project reports, subsidy and incentive applications, and the firm's outreach to new clients.

image.alt: Portrait of Ajay G Vernekar, partner at KAIDS
